intended use: Corrugated metal (sheds, Slifer dorm roof, harbor buildings); combine with M_RustMetal grunge for rusty variants.

notes: nor_gl is OpenGL convention (+Y up); for Unreal flip the green channel. rough is a separate linear map (no ARM pack in this set; sRGB off). Attribution is not required by CC0; credit kept voluntarily.
